Game Overview

School Run Puzzle Adventure puts players into a puzzle experience centered on navigate intricate routes as a school bus driver, solving strategic puzzles in vibrant, cartoony landscapes. Carry just two students at a time, planning each journey carefully. With increasing complexity, obstacles demand quick thinking and smart moves for endless fun. Can you ensure all kids arrive on time?
